To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
adolescents struggle to make healthful eating choices within their home environments, but that they can be supported in this by specific parenting strategies.

adolescents described the following aspects of the home as influencing their eating habits: home cooking, availability/accessibility of foods/beverages in the home, parenting practices, modelling, celebrations and time spent studying and in front of the television.

overweight/obese adolescent girls and boys aged 12–16 years who live in Vancouver, Canada, have difficulty making healthy food choices at home because of the availability, accessibility and appeal of foods in their home environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the experiences of overweight/obesity in adolescence.
the home environment and its impact on food intake.
the role that parents play in the lives of their children.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the home food environment plays a major role in influencing the eating habits of adolescents.
adolescents are struggling with their home food environment to eat healthy.
the home environment is an important context in which to support adolescents in making healthful food choices, but that this is a challenging task for adolescents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
adolescents need to be involved in the process of creating a healthier home environment.
the home food environment can either support or hinder healthful eating.

adolescents are not able to make healthy choices in their home food environment because of the lack of healthful food options, the availability of less healthly food options, and the lack of support from parents to make healthy choices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
parents and caregivers should encourage and model healthful eating and limit access to less healthful foods.
the home environment is not a passive backdrop for adolescents' eating behaviours.
parents and other family members are key in shaping the home food environment and can support adolescents in making healthier choices.
